title: Baby Shower
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office hosts a baby shower with various humorous interactions, including Jan introducing her baby, Michael seeking advice about feeling connected to a baby, and Dwight testing a stroller's durability. The episode features preparations, playful conflicts, and character interactions centered around the theme of impending parenthood.
